doc: Iron supplementation with or without folic acid to reduce the risk of postpartum anaemia in malaria-endemic areas

entries.claim: 在妊娠期贫血为公共卫生问题的地区，产后妇女应补充口服铁剂（单用或联用叶酸）6-12周以降低贫血风险。
entries.source_doc: Iron supplementation with or without folic acid to reduce the risk of postpartum anaemia in malaria-endemic areas

entries.claim: 在疟疾流行区，补充铁和叶酸时应同时实施疟疾预防、诊断和治疗措施，且在使用磺胺多辛-乙胺嘧啶时应避免高剂量叶酸。
